purpose: Withheld-daughter forward-prediction diagnostic suite testing inferred-ancestor vs given-ancestor reflex prediction, ordered counterbleeding rules, non-invertible mergers/deletions, observationally equivalent ancestral symbol labels, etymon-cluster splitting, and overfit/direct-sister baselines.

cases.phenomenon: ordered counterbleeding palatalization and final-vowel lowering (k > tʃ / _i before i > e / _#), final stop deletion (t > Ø / _#), complementary sister mergers (p > f / #_ in b vs i > e / _# and t > Ø / _# in c), observationally equivalent dorsal label (*q vs *ɢ for <a x : b ɢ : c ʔ>), shared-etymon derivative grouping (t07/t08), and unrecoverable pan-sister merger control (u01 w > l / #_ in both b and c).
cases.independent_evidence: 8 development etyma (d01-d08, all daughters a, b, c observed) and 7 validated held-out test etyma across 8 concepts (t01-t08, with t07 and t08 sharing etym_t07; target daughter a strictly withheld) plus 1 underdetermined pan-sister merger control (u01, where both b and c merged *w > l / #_ while a shifted *w > v / #_).
cases.equivalent_solutions: For the dorsal correspondence <b ɢ : c ʔ> (reflex x in a), the generator writes *q at r (with forward rules q > x on a, q > ɢ on b, q > ʔ on c), but reconstructing *ɢ at r (with forward rules ɢ > x on a, identity on b, ɢ > ʔ on c) or a two-stage cascade (q > χ, χ > x on a) is observationally equivalent across all visible data and predicts identical held-out reflexes in daughter a.

u01.note: Pan-sister merger control: both observed sisters b and c underwent w > l / #_, yielding <b l a l a : c l a l a>, which is indistinguishable from ancestral *l a l a (compare d08 *l a q a) when daughter a (v a l a) is masked.

family.name: forward_prediction_v1
family.description: Synthetic family for R06 withheld-daughter forward-prediction feasibility.

branches.note: Target daughter for forward reflex prediction: ordered palatalization before final i-lowering (counterbleeding), final -t deletion, uvular spirantization, and initial w > v.
Sister daughter b: merges initial *p with *f into f and *w with *l into l, voices *q > ɢ, but retains final *-i vs *-e and final *-t.
Sister daughter c: merges final *-i with *-e into -e (without palatalizing k), deletes final *-t, shifts *q > ʔ, and merges *w > l / #_, while retaining initial *p vs *f.
